All Kamen Rider - Rider Generation 2.name: All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation 2
All Kamen Rider - Rider Generation 2.summary: All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation 2 is the sequel to the 2D Beat 'Em Up sidescoller video game, All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation, published by Bandai Namco. It was released on August 2, 2012 for the Nintendo DS and the Sony PSP.

Gaku Ou - The Royal Seven Stars +Meteor.name: Gaku Ou: The Royal Seven Stars + Meteor
Gaku Ou - The Royal Seven Stars +Meteor.summary: This is an all-ages port of the visual novel Gaku ☆ Ou -The Royal Seven Stars- for PlayStation Portable devices. It includes a brand new heroine and a new opening theme.

Twisted Metal - Head-On.name: Twisted Metal: Head-On
Twisted Metal - Head-On.summary: Twisted Metal: Head-On is a vehicular combat video game developed by Incognito Entertainment and released by Sony on March 24, 2005 for the PlayStation Portable and February 5, 2008 for the PlayStation 2. Head-On shares not only the distinction of being the seventh game released in the Twisted Metal series, but also is the first game in the series to ship fully online-enabled.
